shortDescription: Retrieve information on Hetzner's failover IPs

options.name: hetzner_password
options.description: The password for the Robot web-service user.

options.name: hetzner_user
options.description: The username for the Robot web-service user.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for waiting when rate limit exceeded errors are returned. Set to V(0) to not retry. Set to a negative value like V(-1) to retry forever.
